name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $105 as Iran's Hormuz offer awaits a US reply; strait still largely shut
state: Brent was near $105.2 early on 3 Nov, recovering slightly after falling almost 4% on 2 Nov when Iran said it could reopen Hormuz within two days if the US ends its blockade; it is 9% lower on the week but 5% up on the month. Iran said on 2 Nov the 'ball is in the US court' and no US reply had been reported (Al Jazeera). The status stays at Alert under hysteresis while Hormuz remains largely shut.
for_you: Expect continued high petrol, diesel and heating-oil prices, with knock-on effects on transport costs and inflation.
rubric_hit: Brent $105 below $110 Alert line, held by hysteresis; Hormuz largely shut

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran war live: 'Ball in US court'

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
